summary: Adds StartBulkPutItems, DescribeBulkOperation, ListBulkOperations, and CancelBulkOperation for asynchronously loading Amazon S3 datasets into existing DynamoDB tables.

summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports the json-file log driver in task definitions. Daemon task definition volumes also support logDriverVolumeConfiguration, letting managed daemons read those logs.

summary: Added StepAdditionalInfo on DescribeStep and ListSteps to surface YARN application IDs for steps.

summary: Amazon Polly now supports tagging lexicons. Use the new TagResource, UntagResource and ListTagsForResource APIs, or add tags when creating a lexicon with PutLexicon, to organize lexicons and control access with tag-based (ABAC) IAM policies.
title: polly: Amazon Polly now supports tagging lexicons. Use the new TagResource, UntagResource and ListTagsForResource APIs, or add tags when creating a lexicon with PutLexicon, to organize lexicons and control access with tag-based (ABAC) IAM policies.

summary: This release adds Migration Planning artifacts as a source environment for network migration definitions, and an optional clientToken on CreateNetworkMigrationDefinition so that retried requests don't create duplicate definitions.

title: connect: Adds support for retrieving associated cases in contact responses. The Contact object now includes a Cases field containing case IDs and reference numbers linked to the contact.

summary: Adding support for copying and tagging option groups with cross-Region DB snapshot copies, in the same account or across accounts.

title: mwaa-serverless: Adding support to Environment Variables in MWAA Serverless

summary: Amazon S3 Tables now supports migrating AWS Glue Data Catalog tables into S3 Table buckets. This release adds the StartTableMigration, SyncTableMigration, UpdateTableMigration, CompleteTableMigration, GetTableMigration, and ListTableMigrations APIs.

summary: Add the Unsupported SupportabilityScore to GetCapacityManagerSupportabilityScores.
title: ec2: Add the Unsupported SupportabilityScore to GetCapacityManagerSupportabilityScores.

title: securityhub: Release Software APIs- GetSoftwareV2, GetSoftwareStatisticsV2 and GetSoftwareResourcesV2 to list software packages with aggregated resource count, get aggregated software statistics, and find the resources that contain a specific software package.

summary: Adds support for an optional jobName on CreateDatasetExportJob. The jobName is returned by DescribeDatasetExportJob and ListDatasetExportJobs, making dataset export jobs easier to identify and track. If jobName is omitted, a default name is generated automatically.
